item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows four objects Vivaan labels P, Q, R and S: a torch that is switched on, the Moon, a lit match flame, and a white wall.

Which claim about luminous and non-luminous objects is correct?

options.A: P and R are luminous because they emit their own light; Q and S are non-luminous.
options.B: Q is luminous because the Moon looks bright in the night sky.
options.C: S is luminous because a white wall looks bright in sunlight.
options.D: Only P is luminous; a lit match flame does not emit its own light.
